reason_for_new_study: V1 correctly failed source readiness because the historical SGPS L2 operational product does not directly contain the >=10 MeV integral proton quantity assumed by V1 and fixed-day SGPS archive availability is imperfect. V2 separates predictors from labels: documented differential SGPS proton channels are predictors; official NOAA/SWPC proton-event onset/end records define the target and already-active intervals.

xrs_features: for XRS-A and XRS-B separately: finite count, coverage fraction, minimum, maximum, mean, median, standard deviation, last causal value, and age of last causal value
maximum causal first difference and maximum causal log-flux change
proton_features: for each documented SGPS differential proton energy channel retained after source binding: finite count, coverage fraction, minimum, maximum, mean, median, standard deviation, last causal value, and age of last causal value
per-channel maximum causal first difference and maximum causal log-flux change

fixed low-dimensional spectral summaries computed only from simultaneously available differential channels: log-flux slope across energy, low/mid/high-band sums, and spectral curvature when at least three documented bands are available
missingness_features: age of most recent XRS observation
age of most recent SGPS observation
forbidden_features: reconstructed >=10 MeV integral flux used as a predictor
manual event associations or flare/CME metadata selected after outcome inspection

comparators.rule: same hyperparameters/seeds using XRS and missingness features only
same hyperparameters/seeds using differential-proton and missingness features only
constant probability equal to fit-role eligible positive prevalence

thresholds.primary: MAX_TSS selected on threshold role only
thresholds.secondary_diagnostic: minimum false-alert threshold among points with POD >= 0.80 on threshold role only

metrics.uncertainty: paired physical-event/quiet-block bootstrap where support permits; otherwise descriptive intervals only

claim_boundary: This is a retrospective development study designed to create a causally reproducible live-compatible source model for later frozen prospective confirmation. It cannot establish state-of-the-art superiority, independent validation, operational readiness, economic value, or company benefit.
